name: GEVS Level 1 — basic kinematics
description: idle, walks, strafes, turn, sit→stand, wall-absorb. Each check: prompt schedule + scored assertions. Thresholds are calibrated from the measured tai-embodiment-v3 baseline runs of 2026-08-02 (3 runs; docs/gestalt-vn/gevs/baseline-2026-08-02-tai-embodiment-v3/); 'basis' records the measured values each threshold was derived from, with headroom. Locomotion is scored on walked PATH length, not net travel: the stream's heading is stochastic and the room bounds absorb motion, so net displacement is not a deterministic property (recorded as evidence only). 'recenter' re-anchors the avatar at the spawn point (0, 0.15) before the check via the ArdyMotionSource.recenterRoot bench seam, so each check starts from a deterministic spot.
